result.description: TranscriptAPI: REST API and hosted MCP server to fetch YouTube video transcripts, search videos, and browse channels and playlists.
result.auth_detail: REST API: API key sent as Authorization: Bearer header; keys come from the dashboard. OAuth 2.1 is offered only on the hosted MCP server (Claude/ChatGPT clients), not the REST API, so oauth2 is dropped from the REST auth methods.
result.access_detail: Self-serve signup; new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required. Paid plan $5/month for 1,000 credits ($54/year) for more volume.
result.api_notes: Base https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2. About 14 endpoints under /youtube: transcript, info, video metadata, search, channel resolve/info/search/videos/playlists/posts/sections/latest, playlist videos. Credit-metered (1 credit per call, some free). Swagger UI available.

evidence.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the `Authorization` header of every request:
Authentication: OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token (OpenAI Agent Builder and other clients).
You can start for free: new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required, and one transcript costs one credit.
All API requests are made to: https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2
Yes. TranscriptAPI runs an MCP server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp.
Extract YouTube video transcripts with a simple API call or through Model Context Protocol
